description: Set the STI-PA and ACME credentials the stir application uses. Write-only: each value is sealed under the node's key-encryption key at once, and no request ever reads one back. The properties are listed for documentation only: no rule here applies to a value, because the generic validator puts a failing value into the error it builds and Crossbar logs those errors at debug level. stir/api.credentials_request is the gate, and it is value-blind: it refuses a name this API does not keep, an empty value, a value that is not a string, and one longer than 4096 characters, naming only the credential

acme_eab_hmac.description: The HMAC key of the ACME external account binding the STI-CA issued

acme_eab_kid.description: The key id of the ACME external account binding the STI-CA issued
